reason: My son or a neighbour brings the shopping and I am only minutes from Tawfeer. I have no reason to pay strangers to shop for me, and I would still have to walk to a pickup point in the evening.
objection: Why would I pay someone to shop for me when my family already brings it and the supermarket is close? I do not know these people, and no home delivery means I still have to go out.
would_change_my_mind: Home delivery to my door, from someone my neighbours already know and trust.
